_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR EVERY IMAGE AND VIDEO ON THE SITE.
Everything listed here is currently a generated placeholder. To swap in real
NOTE: assets/venue-*.jpg ARE real photographs of the venue. Everything in assets/placeholders/ is still generated and awaiting real interior photos.
media: put the files in assets/ (or paste a remote URL), edit the paths below,
then run `python3 tools/build.py`. Nothing else needs touching — the hero,
the page images and the gallery all read from this file.
src may be a local path ('assets/room-01.jpg') or an absolute URL
('https://images.example.com/room.jpg'). Local is preferred: it survives the
host going away and keeps Lighthouse happy.
alt is REQUIRED on every entry. It is what screen readers announce and what
search engines index. Describe the photo, don't repeat the venue name.
Set placeholders:false once real media is in — it hides the preview banner.

hero._note: Poster should be a frame from the clip so the fade-in is seamless. WebM first (smaller), MP4 second for Safari. A single MP4 is fine if that is all you have.
